SELECT
TO_CHAR(v.VOUCHER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as dateKey
TO_CHAR(v.VOUCHER_DATE, 'YYYY-WW') as dateKey
TO_CHAR(v.VOUCHER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') as dateKey
TO_CHAR(v.VOUCHER_DATE, 'YYYY-"Q"Q') as dateKey
TO_CHAR(v.VOUCHER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') as dateKey
, COUNT(1) as count, COALESCE(SUM(v.TOTAL_DEBIT), 0) as amount FROM T_ACCOUNTING_VOUCHER v WHERE v.IS_DELETED = 0
AND v.BOOK_ID = #{param.bookId}
AND v.TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId}
AND v.VOUCHER_DATE >= #{param.startDate}
AND v.VOUCHER_DATE <= #{param.endDate}
GROUP BY
TO_CHAR(v.VOUCHER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(v.VOUCHER_DATE, 'YYYY-WW')
TO_CHAR(v.VOUCHER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
TO_CHAR(v.VOUCHER_DATE, 'YYYY-"Q"Q')
TO_CHAR(v.VOUCHER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY dateKey
SELECT DISTINCT ACCOUNTING_PERIOD FROM T_ACCOUNTING_VOUCHER WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND ACCOUNTING_PERIOD IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACCOUNTING_PERIOD DESC

SELECT vt.VOUCHER_TYPE_ID as typeId, vt.VOUCHER_TYPE_NAME as typeName, vt.VOUCHER_TYPE_CODE as typeCode FROM T_VOUCHER_TYPE vt WHERE vt.IS_DELETED = 0 AND vt.BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND vt.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} ORDER BY vt.VOUCHER_TYPE_CODE

SELECT DISTINCT v.PREPARER as preparerId, s.STAFF_NAME as preparerName FROM T_ACCOUNTING_VOUCHER v LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF s ON v.PREPARER = s.STAFF_ID WHERE v.IS_DELETED = 0 AND v.BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND v.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND v.PREPARER IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.STAFF_NAME

SELECT DISTINCT ve.CURRENCY_CODE as currencyCode, ve.CURRENCY_NAME as currencyName FROM T_VOUCHER_ENTRY ve INNER JOIN T_ACCOUNTING_VOUCHER v ON ve.VOUCHER_ID = v.VOUCHER_ID WHERE v.IS_DELETED = 0 AND ve.IS_DELETED = 0 AND v.BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND v.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND ve.CURRENCY_CODE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ve.CURRENCY_CODE

SELECT TO_CHAR(v.VOUCHER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') as month, COUNT(1) as count, COALESCE(SUM(v.TOTAL_DEBIT), 0) as amount FROM T_ACCOUNTING_VOUCHER v WHERE v.IS_DELETED = 0 AND v.BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND v.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND TO_CHAR(v.VOUCHER_DATE, 'YYYY') = #{year} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(v.VOUCHER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month
